definitions.explanation: A flat board used as a surface for cutting food in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: まな{板|いた}の{上|うえ}で{肉|にく}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: Cut meat on the cutting board.

examples.japanese: まな{板|いた}を{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}で{消毒|しょうどく}する。
examples.english: Disinfect the cutting board with bleach.
A carp on the cutting board. (Idiom: Someone who is at the mercy of others)
examples.notes: Describes helpless resignation to one's fate

notes:
Also written as {俎板|まないた} or {俎|まないた} (rare).

Materials:
- {木製|もくせい} (wooden) - traditional, gentle on knives
- プラスチック{製|せい} (plastic) - easy to clean, affordable
- ゴム{製|せい} (rubber) - quiet, knife-friendly
- {抗菌|こうきん}タイプ (antibacterial type)

Many Japanese kitchens have separate boards for:
- {肉|にく}/{魚|さかな}{用|よう} (meat/fish)
- {野菜|やさい}{用|よう} (vegetables)

The idiom 「まな{板|いた}の{鯉|こい}」 describes accepting one's fate helplessly, like a fish waiting to be prepared.
